mapper.insert: INSERT INTO node_info( id, name, ip, ip_long, uuid, type, tag, user_name, password, cabinet_id, u_size, cabinet_start, snmp_port, snmp_community, remark, operator, op_time )VALUES( seq_nextval('seq_node_info_id'), #{name}, #{ip}, #{ipLong}, seq_nextval('seq_node_info_uuid'), #{type}, #{tag}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{cabinetId}, #{uSize}, #{cabinetStart}, #{snmpPort}, #{snmpCommunity}, #{remark}, #{operator}, #{opTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT ni.* FROM system_info si LEFT JOIN system_node_rel snr ON si.id=snr.system_id LEFT JOIN node_info ni ON snr.uuid=ni.uuid WHERE si.id=#{id} AND si.del_flag=0 AND snr.del_flag=0 AND ni.state=3
